scope.pcfUploadEvent: pcf.upload.settled remains the top-level envelope owned by PCF_CLUSTER_FIRST_PROCESSING_ARCHITECTURE_PLAN.md

envelope.payloadSource: owning Firestore trigger before/after snapshot plus only the named exact-path enrichment for that event type

sourceRevision.deleteInput: before snapshot updateTime, except a retained inactive pcfProjectionRoutePolicies control uses its after snapshot updateTime as a logical tombstone
sourceRevision.ordering: compare normalized updateTime, then operation rank
sourceRevision.reason: Firestore delivery is unordered and at-least-once. For physical source documents, delete oldValue has the last document updateTime, so delete rank wins that prior upsert and a later recreation wins the tombstone. Effective retention policy is derived from multiple source documents whose updateTime values are not mutually orderable, so its source handlers first commit one retained canonical control generation; an inactive canonical generation is a logical tombstone ordered by that document's after updateTime.

projection.pcf_container.changed.pageNumbersRule: sorted unique source page numbers, including pages with zero recognized items, so active image/detail serving does not lose empty pages
projection.pcf_container.changed.guaranteedRule: null or exact {isGuaranteed:true, guaranteeExpiresAt:<Google RFC3339 timestamp>}; guarantee state is user-visible serving data and participates in the business hash
projection.pcf_container.changed.namedExactPathEnrichment: at most one parent routes/{route}/pcfs/{delivery} read when loadingDate/active state is absent or to prove parent/child fixture-marker consistency before ordinary data enters the business projection

projection.pcf_retention.changed.sourcePath: pcfProjectionRoutePolicies/{route}, the retained canonical effective-policy control document
projection.pcf_retention.changed.authorityRule: an enqueue-before-ack source handler resolves routes.ownerUid, then routeEntitlements.ownerUid, then routeNumbers.userId; it transactionally updates the retained canonical control document only when effective state changes and then enqueues that exact canonical generation
projection.pcf_retention.changed.logicalTombstoneRule: the canonical document is retained with active=false; the emitted event uses mutationKind=delete, payload=null, and the retained document after.updateTime with delete rank so later reactivation wins monotonically
projection.pcf_retention.changed.namedExactPathEnrichment: none in the canonical-policy event producer; authority resolution is owned by the preceding source handler

projection.notification_recipient.change.routeNumbersSource: the same primary profile.routeNumber plus profile.additionalRoutes plus routeAssignments key union used by the current access resolver
projection.notification_recipient.change.deliveryMinuteLocalRule: integer 0 through 1439 in the named IANA zone; producer converts the existing 12-hour setting before enqueue
projection.notification_recipient.change.tokenRule: only presence plus a domain-separated token-set hash may cross ingress; dispatch still performs one exact current-user read
ignoredBeforeEnqueue: profile noise outside the notification/access fingerprint

businessHash.algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 compact JSON with sorted object keys, domain-separated by version
businessHash.arrayOrdering: event-type normalizer sorts set-like arrays and preserves ordered item identity
included: normalized upsert payload or explicit tombstone marker

pcfWorkInputHash.computedBy: cluster only after manifest and OCR-context validation
pcfWorkInputHash.algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 Python JSON with sorted keys and compact separators
pcfWorkInputHash.ocrContextRule: canonical MM/DD/YYYY delivery date plus exact manifest-container coverage; every container date must match the human-validated delivery date; only bounded OCR-affecting SSCC provenance participates

tombstones.repair: daily route checksum/watermark reconciliation uses the same exact fixture predicate and emits a newer source revision; updatedAt-only discovery is forbidden

expiring.encoding: compact sorted-key JSON with expiryDate YYYY-MM-DD

lifecycle.encoding: compact sorted-key JSON with effectiveBusinessDate YYYY-MM-DD

routeReconciliation.sourceSnapshotBoundary: the bounded Firestore read time encoded as fsut1 rank 0; it is an audit and concurrency fence, not an entity mutation revision
routeReconciliation.sourceMembers: current non-fixture container upserts for exactly one eligible route, each at or before the source snapshot boundary
routeReconciliation.projectionMembers: non-deleted items_current rows for exactly that route
routeReconciliation.projectionIntegrity: recompute each business hash from actual active/loading_date/page_numbers/items content and require the stored source_business_hash to match it
routeReconciliation.projectionAheadRule: if last_projected_revision is newer than the source snapshot boundary, take a fresh source snapshot and perform no repair
routeReconciliation.missingOrChangedRepair: replay only the exact current source upsert through normal ingress
routeReconciliation.extraRepair: a checksum difference is not deletion authority; first perform one exact missing-document read for the named source path, then emit a deterministic tombstone fenced by that readTime
routeReconciliation.laterRecreationRule: a later Firestore recreation updateTime is newer than the absence-read tombstone and wins through normal per-entity revision ordering
routeReconciliation.orchestrationBounds: preflight PostgreSQL eligibility before any Firestore read; at most two one-route source snapshots and one atomic repair transaction per run; all repairs use normal ingress receipts and lifecycle replanning
routeReconciliation.servingAuthority: a matched reconciliation may record parity and bounded health only; it never creates eligibility or enables serving

idempotency.duplicateSourceEventId: return the committed accepted/rejected identity without another projection or work write
idempotency.equalRevisionDifferentMutationOrHash: persist bounded revision_conflict rejection and alert
idempotency.newerUpsertSameBusinessHash: advance entity/route watermark only; create no due work and perform no Firebase effect
idempotency.newerChangedBusinessOrTombstone: apply projection transaction and deterministically upsert affected due work
idempotency.unknownSchemaOrEventType: persist bounded deterministic rejection, alert, acknowledge transport, and do not block later route events
idempotency.commitUnknownOrDependencyFailure: return transient failure so Cloud Tasks retries

excludedBy: authoritative automationExcluded metadata plus exact fixture identity/generation
fixtures.route988200: real entities remain production data; only signed exact fixture keys are excluded
fixtures.route900000: normal production/app-review data and observe-only for rollout, never a fixture or route exclusion
